title: Per-Lap Telemetry
description: JSON Schema for a single lap's telemetry data produced by R.py. Each file is named {lap}_tel.json and contains high-frequency car data sampled at ~3.7 Hz.

time.description: Time in seconds relative to the start of the lap.

throttle.description: Throttle position as a percentage. Values are typically 0-100 but may occasionally exceed 100 due to interpolation or raw sensor values.

brake.description: Brake application state. 0 = not braking, 1 = braking.

drs.description: Drag Reduction System state. 0 = closed, 1 = open.

distance.description: Distance travelled since the start of the lap in metres.

rel_distance.description: Normalized distance along the lap (0.0 = first sample, 1.0 = last sample). Tiny negative values may occur due to floating-point interpolation.

DriverAhead.description: Car number of the driver directly ahead, or 'None' if unavailable.

DistanceToDriverAhead.description: Distance to the car ahead in metres, or 'None' if unavailable.

x.description: X coordinate in metres (horizontal track position).

y.description: Y coordinate in metres (horizontal track position).

z.description: Z coordinate in metres (vertical track position / elevation).

dataKey.description: Unique identifier linking this telemetry to a specific year, event, session, driver and lap. Format: {Year}-{EventName}-{Session}-{Driver}-{LapNumber}
